span.normalized: Beyond these contracted sources, IperionX has a number of potential sources of liquidity: Customer receipts are expected to grow as the Virginia facility moves from prototype and qualification work into low-rate production; IperionX has purchase orders and supply arrangements with the U.S. Army (DEVCOM Ground Vehicle Systems Center), American Rheinmetall, Ford Motor Company and Carver Pump, among others. The remaining $79.2 million of ceiling under the SBIR Phase III task order awarded and other awards referred to above may be accessed through further task orders at the Government's discretion.
